purpose: Zero-Boost & High-RPM VCT Angle Lockout (Thermal Reversion & Shift Lag Elimination)

tune.status: Tested on road in paired-20261105-150046-e5d55c90-v036-forrealsies; thermal protection confirmed, superseded by v037

changes_since_previous_run: Derived from paired-20261105-104453-2eb3afbb-v035 telemetry review, confirmed built engine specs (85.5mm forged pistons, ~2.02L displacement, 9.25:1 static CR), and owner-approved high-RPM lockout: (1) Zeros [ECM] 44412 VCT Angle across boost rows 0.70, 0.80, and 1.00 (0.00 deg across 1,000-7,200 RPM) to halt superheated exhaust gas reversion into intake runners under boost; (2) Locks out columns 4,500 through 7,200 RPM to 0.00 deg across ALL loads (0.10-1.00) to eliminate phaser hydraulic slew lag (200-300 ms) and shift reversion hesitation; (3) Preserves cruise VCT advance across rows 0.10-0.50 below 4,000 RPM; (4) Retains full v035 MBT spark advance (13.5 deg flat Row 9), v035 base fuel targets (0.76-0.77 lambda), v033 loud decel crackle, and v032 anti-shuffle fixes.

profile.filename: profiles/2004 Focus SVT - V023 Idle Spark Trial.Channels.xml
profile.status: All 18 requested channels required; paired with SCG-1 wideband lambda

conditions.accessories: Standard driving; A/C OFF during pulls
conditions.driver_tip_in_procedure: Apply 10-20% throttle for 0.5-1.0s out of DFCO before committing to 100% WOT to eliminate lean hesitation

stop_conditions: Wideband lambda > 0.82 (> 12.0 AFR) under boost > 8 psi
Boost spike > 15.5 psi (approaching 16 psi SCG-1 cut)
Engine stall or severe undershoot (< 700 RPM) on clutch-in
Engine coolant temp > 220 F or rapid thermal spike
